convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iATR indicator and standard MQL5 Trade library. Simple pending order entry/exit rules. Fixed lot sizing. No custom indicators or external trading logic libraries.

derived_values.name: Fixed trailing stop distance in price

params.basis: rates[1].low for buy, rates[1].high for sell

other_exits: OnTradeTransaction deletes remaining pending order when one side fills (OCO-like behavior via DEAL_ENTRY_IN detection)

custom_logic_notes: Dual pending stop orders placed around Doji bar (buy stop at high, sell stop at low). OCO behavior: when one pending order fills, the other is deleted via OnTradeTransaction detecting DEAL_ENTRY_IN. Trailing stop only moves SL when position is profitable (plDPts >= spread). Trailing SL set relative to rates[1].close +/- fixed distance. Doji defined as body <= 3% of total bar range.
python_conversion_notes: Strategy is bar-based on D1, making Python conversion straightforward. Doji detection is trivial (body <= 3% of range). ATR is standard. Pending order logic requires OCO implementation: place both buy-stop and sell-stop after a Doji, cancel the unfilled one when the other triggers. Trailing stop uses fixed point distance (2700 points) and only trails when profitable. No tick-level logic needed. Entry uses previous bar (index 1) values, not current bar.
